jet_list.title: F-35I
jet_list.desc: The most advanced stealth fighter in the world, able to strike unseen deep behind enemy lines.

notes.rcs: front 0.0015 m2: the low end of GlobalSecurity's 0.0015-0.005 for the F-35 (quoted by MiGFlug, second-hand; disputed); side, rear, the open bays (1 m2) and 0.5 m2 per loaded external station inferred (external stores 'drastically increase' it, National Interest); docs/ai.md 15.2
notes.gear_limit: Flight data Real: the F-35A's gear limit is open (no public figure); the F-16's 300 KCAS / Mach 0.65 (inferred), docs/damage.md 5.2
notes.drag_chute: no F-16 or F-35 has a drag chute: the flight never asks the flight model for one
notes.sixdof: Physics Flight model on 6-DoF: Modern IAF's 6-DoF from its own data (modern-iaf/docs/flight-model.md §9; docs/deviations.md §2)
notes.radar.km: AN/APG-81, multiple-target track beyond 80 NM (U, docs/f35i.md)
notes.radar.auto: no radar switch: the mission systems run the radar, so it comes up in STBY with power and searches once airborne in both games (inferred, modern-iaf/docs/research/f35-cockpit.md §2; docs/radar.md §9.1)
notes.radar.fcr: Modern IAF only (Settings.modern_radar): the real FCR's controls on the shared radar code, its search, TWS, STT, ACM, the cursor and the TMS keys, the A-S ground map with its SAR picture (DBS), GMT and SEA (docs/radar.md §9; modern-iaf/docs/avionics-plan.md A2-A5); the APG-81's "multiple target track" (Wikipedia, AN/APG-81) as four bugs kept while searching (the count inferred: the (V)9's)
notes.ews: Modern IAF only: the TWD with the range's emitters, the DAS's missile warning ("missile detection and tracking", Wikipedia, AN/AAQ-37) as the Sufa's MAW, the data link on from the start (MADL / Link 16, inferred: no DL switch) and the combat ID (aiff.rs combat_id, inferred); no manual AIFF interrogation (modern-iaf/docs/avionics-plan.md A7, E5, N9, P5)
notes.gun_rounds: GAU-22/A 25 mm, 180 rounds (the 20 MM record stands in)
notes.gun: GAU-22/A: 3,300 rounds a minute, 1,040 m/s (docs/f35i.md §3); the 20 MM record's blast and damage stay
notes.voice.real: the pull-up call only (Auto-GCAS lineage, docs/real-betty.md)
notes.voice.real_betty: Extras Real Betty: the F-16 VMS set, as Modern IAF takes it (the F-35I's own list is open, docs/real-betty.md)
notes.engine_spool: F135-PW-100: flight idle -> maximum power about 6 s (Pratt & Whitney); the split inferred (docs/flight-model.md §10.2)
notes.goggles: the helmet's night camera, drawn as the late Gen III; its cockpit lit for it (docs/rendering.md §8.3)
